feature_name: Small Text File Handling for AI Fields
description: Implement a solution for AI fields to properly process very small text files that were previously being ignored by the model. When users upload small text files (≤10KB), embed the file content directly in the prompt instead of using the Files API upload flow. Additionally, improve file metadata visibility and provide feedback when files cannot be processed.
functional_requirements: Inline small text files (≤10KB) by sending their decoded UTF-8 content directly in the prompt, falling back to binary representation for non-UTF-8 files
Use user-visible filenames instead of storage names when presenting file information to the AI model
Include clear feedback in the prompt when files are excluded due to unsupported formats or size limitations
Update prompt wording to clarify that file contents are provided as context rather than being 'attached'
Refactor file preparation logic into modular helper functions for maintainability
Update the AI model dependency to support the new text content embedding functionality
